scope: Data preservation and precise source-based test strategy for a frontend-only bilingual icon repair. This report does not claim the repaired UI has passed browser tests.
headline: 191 个数据载荷全部与上一轮已通过审计的版本逐字节一致；全站中英数据块完整。原站图标已逐源实例映射，供对照模式按列验证。

dataPreservation.unchangedTextCodeLinksAndTables: All authoritative content JSON literals and classic script bytes are identical to the previously validated payloads. The previous complete source-to-English, Chinese reviewed-content, code/non-comment, link/API binding, table, anchor and image checks therefore remain applicable.

sourceIconCoverage.mappingGranularity: Every article occurrence maps to pageId + blockId + iconName; heading anchors include the original anchor. Every source SVG includes its original XPath and source geometry pattern identity.
sourceIconCoverage.compareRequirement: Each listed source occurrence has one icon associated with the English fragment and one with the Chinese fragment. A single shared icon outside both language lanes fails this requirement.
sourceIconCoverage.additionalRuntimeIconsAllowed: API section heading anchors and other application controls can add runtime icons. Source coverage is checked by the mapped block/language identity, never by assuming the entire DOM total must equal 1,606 or 3,212.
sourceIconCoverage.footerScope: The 750 original edit/previous/next icons are source page chrome. Local navigation is shared; these are inventoried separately and are not asserted as bilingual article duplicates.

nonSvgSourceControls.note: Individual page button totals remain in pages[].raw.button. Verbose duplicate code-toolbar and universal lightbox-close examples are collapsed here; no article control is collapsed.

requiredRuntimeAssertions: Render a case through the real app at en/zh/compare modes. Find source fragments by block ID plus data-source-language.
Compare fragment textContent exactly to the recorded textContent after excluding data-source-ui nodes. Do not normalize pre whitespace.
Compare each pre text exactly and by recorded SHA; copy controls must copy the same string.
For nonshared compare blocks require distinct EN and ZH fragments, not a fallback copy of English.
Verify href/text bindings and table-cell text order match the fixture for each language.
Use source-icon-expectations.json to check every expected icon by source block and language, not total SVG count alone.
newFrontendRegressionFixtures.helperUiExclusion: Ignore only nodes explicitly marked data-source-ui when comparing source fragment text. Keep original links, original prose and code.

rootBrowserStrategyAlignment.compareLanguageColumns: Check icon kind plus SVG geometry separately in EN and ZH. Page totals alone cannot detect a missing Chinese icon offset by an unrelated English icon.
rootBrowserStrategyAlignment.sharedCode: Unchanged code is intentionally shared once; source-fragment must declare en zh sharing. Code with translated comments must have distinct language fragments.
rootBrowserStrategyAlignment.dataColumns: Source fixture text, pre contents, link href/text, images, aside types, table cells and checkboxes should be verified within the correct block/language fragment.
rootBrowserStrategyAlignment.responsiveGeometry: Title/body divider alignment and clipping are layout properties for root browser checks, not determined from immutable payload hashes.

limitations: The prior passing content audit does not establish correctness of new frontend transformations; the new fixture cases and source icon mappings are intended for those runtime assertions.
No browser, layout engine, screenshot or server was used in this task. UI parity and visual geometry remain with root/browser QA.

The original source icon inventory is complete within official main/article/footer regions. Global application chrome and CSS-only toolbar symbols are separately scoped controls, not article SVG occurrences.
